patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, distinct content blocks, often featuring a dominant image or illustration on one side and text on the other, sometimes with text wrapping around circular elements.
A sophisticated typographic hierarchy blending an elegant serif for main headings, a decorative script font for section titles, and a clean monospace or sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A warm, earthy color palette featuring muted beige, reddish-brown, and dark green, used for full-bleed section backgrounds to create strong visual breaks and mood shifts.
The hero section dynamically swaps its central illustration for a video or photo upon initial scroll, and subsequent sections reveal with distinct full-screen background changes and large typography.
Sections are often separated or accented by custom, hand-drawn illustrative elements like leaves, swirls, or geometric patterns, reinforcing a unique, artisanal brand aesthetic.

technique_notes: The hero area uses a scroll-triggered mechanism (likely GSAP or CSS keyframes) to transition its primary visual content from a static illustration to a dynamic video or photo, while maintaining the main heading text in place.

Full-bleed sections with strong, contrasting background colors and large, stylized typography are introduced as visual interruptions, likely using a scroll-triggered reveal or fade effect to create distinct thematic breaks.
A gallery section implements a horizontal scrolling mechanism to display multiple images within a confined vertical space, allowing users to explore content without excessive vertical scrolling.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) and decorative script titles (~2-3x body) are paired with smaller, legible monospace and sans-serif body text, creating a balanced yet distinctive hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded, with prominent oval shapes for hero content and images, and soft corners for other elements, contributing to a gentle and organic feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a relaxed and unhurried rhythm that allows content to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of elegant serif, decorative script, and monospace typography, combined with custom hand-drawn illustrations and dynamic hero content transitions, creates a unique, artisanal brand identity that feels both sophisticated and playfully authentic.
